Tourist Assaults Man in Mussoorie After Car Collision

A tourist from Gurugram reportedly assaulted a local man in Mussoorie following a car collision. Video footage shows the tourist chasing the man with an empty milk crate and damaging cars. The incident has drawn attention to tourist behavior in the popular hill station.
